Here are the most relevant results from Ticketek Australia's help/FAQ pages on ticket delivery:

## Main Ticket Delivery Help Pages

**1. Ticket Delivery FAQs** (help.ticketek.com.au/hc/en-us/articles/360001877308-Ticket-Delivery-FAQs)
This is the primary FAQ page covering ticket delivery questions. Key information includes:

- When purchasing tickets, the available delivery options will be listed beneath your ticket selection. These options may vary depending on the event, venue, or even the ticket type.
- A delivery delay is a temporary hold on ticket access after purchase. Promoters may request this to help manage ticket limits and reduce the risk of scalping through bots or other unfair methods. If a delay is in place, your tickets won't be sent, and any mobile or app ticket barcodes will remain locked until approximately 48 hours before your event.
- If you haven't received your tickets or your barcode is still locked on the day of the event, please visit the box office when you arrive.
- As long as someone is holding a valid ticket, they will be allowed entry. You can also share tickets through your order history in your My Ticketek account.

**Delivery Options Explained:**
- App Ticket: Tickets will be available via the Ticketek App. Barcodes will remain locked until approximately 48 hours before the event and cannot be added to your wallet or shared until unlocked.
- Mobile Ticket: Accessible via the Ticketek App, your confirmation email, or your order history on the Ticketek website. Barcodes may remain locked until 48 hours before the event and cannot be added to a wallet or shared until that time.
- EzyTicket (Email): Tickets are emailed to your registered email address for you to print.
- Souvenir or Collector Tickets: These are physical tickets printed on commemorative stock and mailed to the address provided during checkout. Delivery may take longer, and availability is limited to certain events. Not all events offer this option, and they cannot be replaced if lost or damaged.

**2. Ticket Delivery Category Page** (help.ticketek.com.au/hc/en-us/categories/360000153687-Ticket-Delivery)
This category page covers Ticket Delivery and Ticket Sharing, including Delivery Information, Ticket Delivery Information - Live Updates, Mobile Tickets and Sharing, App/Mobile Ticket Information, and Ticket Sharing Info Guide.

**3. Ticket Delivery Information - Live Updates** (help.ticketek.com.au/hc/en-us/articles/360001861348)
If you have not received your tickets, please visit the venue box office on the day of the event for assistance. Staff there will be able to provide your tickets and help ensure you can attend without issue.

**4. Mobile Ticket Delivery** (premier.ticketek.com.au)
When you purchase your ticket and choose Ticketek Mobile Ticket as your delivery option, you will be required to enter your name and your mobile phone number as part of the purchase process. You also have the choice to enter multiple mobile phone numbers to have tickets in your order sent to your friends. Once the purchase is complete, an SMS will be sent to each phone number you have entered containing the event information and a web link. By clicking this link, a web page will be displayed containing your ticket.

**Other Useful Pages:**
- **Main Help Hub:** help.ticketek.com.au/hc/en-us
- **Contact Ticketek:** Call 1300 665 915 for additional support with your booking. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am – 5pm (AEST)
- **Submit a Request:** help.ticketek.com.au/hc/en-us/requests/new

For additional changes: Please review the delivery options carefully before completing your purchase, as these cannot be changed once your order is confirmed. The delivery methods offered at checkout are the only ones available for that event or ticket type.
